# Forsa Design

> Forsa Design is an industrial web design studio based in Banff, Aberdeenshire. We build fast, hand-coded websites and bespoke web systems for offshore, energy, engineering, industrial equipment, logistics and manufacturing businesses across the UK and EU.

## Services

Industrial web presence, B2B e-commerce for parts and equipment, procurement-ready websites, bespoke web systems, ERP/stock integrations, performance optimisation and technical SEO.

## Founder

Miro Potaczek founded Forsa Design after more than 20 years in international B2B industrial sales, working with metalworking machinery, engineering solutions and industrial equipment across Europe and Asia. He understands both sides of the procurement table and speaks English and Polish.
